## Day-06 — Arrays

**⚠️ Common mistakes**

- Confusing 0-based indexing: the last element is at `array.length - 1`, not `array.length`.
- Trying to access an out-of-bounds index returns `undefined`, not an error.

---

## Day-07 — Objects

**⚠️ Common mistakes**

- Using bracket notation with an unquoted key name instead of a variable (`person[name]` vs `person["name"]`).
- Forgetting that object keys are strings or Symbols.
